title: Degree adverbs in a legal judgement

sections.title: What is new
sections.content: You know degree adverbs from C1 Unit 19 (*számottevően*, *drasztikusan*). In a legal judgement they grade how far a rule is kept or broken. What is new in this lesson is *maradéktalanul* ('completely, without anything left over') and *részben* ('in part') next to *számottevően*, and the vocabulary of the state and its limits.

sections.title: Example
sections.content: Example: *A törvény a jogbiztonság követelményeinek maradéktalanul megfelel.* The degree adverb stands before the verb it grades. *Megfelel* takes the dative: *megfelel a követelményeknek*.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A törvény a jogbiztonság követelményeinek maradéktalanul megfelel.
The law fully meets the requirements of legal certainty.
A kormány hatásköre az új szabály miatt számottevően nőtt.
The government's competence grew significantly because of the new rule.
A rendelet csak részben felel meg az Alaptörvénynek.
The decree meets the Fundamental Law only in part.
